module.purpose: Provides browser-based text measurement for the editor, including HTML sizing, batched measurement, grapheme-level span geometry, wrapping, truncation, and ellipsis placement.
module.summary: This manager owns hidden DOM measurement elements attached to the editor container. It normalizes text, applies typography and wrapping styles, measures rendered dimensions through browser layout APIs, reuses pooled elements for batch requests, and derives grapheme-level boxes for export and text layout. It preserves and restores styles around measurements and cleans up all created elements when disposed.
module.businessContext: Supports accurate text rendering, editing, and export in the drawing editor. Failures can cause incorrect text bounds, wrapping, truncation, alignment, or exported SVG geometry.

functions: resolveLineHeightPx (~L15-17): Converts unitless line-height into whole-pixel spacing
normalizeTextForDom (~L21-27): Normalizes line endings and preserves empty lines

measureText (~L243-248): Converts plain text to HTML-safe DOM content before measurement

measureElementTextNodeSpans (~L274-375): Derives grapheme span boxes from rendered text nodes
measureTextSpans (~L382-460): Measures text spans with wrapping and truncation behavior
systemCapabilities: Align measurement with rendering and export

typeShapes.name: TLMeasureTextOpts
typeShapes.shape:
{
	fontStyle: string
	fontWeight: string
	fontFamily: string
	fontSize: number
	/** This must be a number, e.g. 1.35, not a pixel value. */
	lineHeight: number
	/**
	 * When maxWidth is a number, the text will be wrapped to that maxWidth. When maxWidth
	 * is null, the text will be measured without wrapping, but explicit line breaks and
	 * space are preserved.
	 */
	maxWidth: null | number
	minWidth?: null | number
	// todo: make this a number so that it is consistent with other TLMeasureTextSpanOpts
	padding: string
	otherStyles?: Record<string, string>
	disableOverflowWrapBreaking?: boolean
	measureScrollWidth?: boolean
}

detail.summary: TextManager provides browser-backed text measurement infrastructure for an editor, including a primary measurement element and reusable pooled elements. It extends EditorManager and is attached to the editor's container.

detail.name: createMeasurementEl
preconditions: The editor provides a container document supporting createElement and DOM element configuration.
postconditions: Returns an HTMLDivElement created by the editor's container document.
The element has the classes tl-text and tl-text-measure.
The element has dir set to auto and tabIndex set to -1.
The element is initialized with the entries from initialDefaultStyles.
invariants: The returned element is a div element configured as a non-focusable text measurement element.
edgeCases: If the editor's container document cannot create the element or a DOM operation fails, the underlying exception propagates and no element is returned.

raises: Underlying document or DOM operation errors

stateMutations: Mutates the newly created DOM element's class list, attributes, tab index, and styles.

postconditions: Each string-valued property differs from its previous value only when its previous value was different, and is then set to the supplied string.

units.name: measureTextSpans

detail.name: measureTextSpans
detail.signature:
measureTextSpans(
		textToMeasure: string,
		opts: TLMeasureTextSpanOpts
	): { text: string; box: BoxModel }[]
preconditions: opts contains the text layout, dimensions, overflow, padding, and style values required by TLMeasureTextSpanOpts.
The TextManager measurement element is available and can be styled and rendered in the current document context.
postconditions: For non-empty input, returns measured text spans with a text value and BoxModel for each span.
The measurement element's temporary styles are restored after measurement, including when measurement raises an error.
For empty input, returns an empty array without measuring the text.
invariants: Measurement uses normalized DOM text rather than the raw input text.
The measurement element is configured using the supplied font, line-height, width, alignment, overflow, word-breaking, and other style options while measurement is in progress.
Returned spans reflect browser-rendered character positions and are ordered in rendered text order.
When overflow is truncate-clip or truncate-ellipsis, measurement is limited to the first rendered line.
Ellipsis truncation accounts for the measured ellipsis width before final span measurement and appends a separate ellipsis span when measurable truncated text remains.
edgeCases: An empty string returns [] immediately.
When overflow is truncate-clip, text is measured with first-line truncation and no synthetic ellipsis is appended.

When overflow is truncate-ellipsis and the text is truncated, the ellipsis is measured, available width is reduced by its ceiling width, and a separate '…' span is appended after the final truncated span.
When ellipsis truncation leaves no measurable text span, the truncated spans are returned without dereferencing or appending an ellipsis span.
Input containing DOM-normalization-sensitive whitespace or line breaks is normalized before being rendered and measured.
If browser measurement or style setup fails, the error propagates after temporary styles are restored.

raises: Errors thrown by text normalization, DOM rendering, style application, or span measurement propagate to the caller.

stateMutations: Temporarily changes the measurement element's styles and restores them before returning or propagating an error.
Temporarily changes the measurement element's textContent during measurement and ellipsis measurement.
detail.ioFormatSpec: Input is a string plus TLMeasureTextSpanOpts. Output is an array of objects shaped { text: string; box: BoxModel }, where boxes are derived from browser-rendered character geometry.
detail.summary: Measures text in the browser's current layout context and returns text fragments split at rendered line and word boundaries, each with its measured box. It supports normal wrapping and first-line truncation, including ellipsis placement for ellipsis truncation.

specLiterals.role: Selects first-line truncation with a synthetic ellipsis span.
Selects first-line truncation without appending an ellipsis.
The ellipsis character appended for truncate-ellipsis output.
Unit used for computed font size, line height, element width, and adjusted truncation width styles.
Measurement element height style used while laying out text.
Overflow-wrap value used for first-line truncation.
Overflow-wrap value used for normal wrapping.
Word-break value used for first-line truncation.
Word-break value used for normal wrapping.

specTests.then: It returns [] without performing text measurement.
The result contains only spans from the first rendered line and does not include a synthetic '…' span.
The result contains the truncated measured spans followed by a separate span whose text is '…', positioned within the available width after accounting for the ellipsis width.
